name: 20" Lightweight Hardshell Spinner Carry-On Luggage - Rose Pink / Coral
description: Selling a highly vibrant 20-inch hardshell spinner carry-on luggage in an eye-catching rose pink/coral color. Built with a lightweight ABS/PC textured exterior shell featuring a unique staggered geometric column line design that naturally deflects impacts. Equipped with 360-degree multi-directional spinner wheels and an ergonomic telescoping top pull-up handle bar for effortless airport terminal navigation. Fits seamlessly into standard aircraft overhead compartments. **Flaw Transparency Management**: This item has been actively used for international flights and shows normal transit cosmetic wear, including airline sticker residues, a red 'Fragile' sticker on the front, and minor surface micro-scuffs on the corners. All wheels, zippers, and handles are entirely functional and intact. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. The interior lining has been completely vacuumed and the exterior wiped down and sanitized, though minor pet dust particles might remain due to static. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging or dust bags; please prep your vehicle's trunk space for pickup.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and functional. Ready to slide into any standard sedan trunk or backseat. From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: 20-inch rose pink hardshell spinner carry-on luggage for sale. Standard airline cabin size, 360-degree wheels, fully functional. Sanitized, good condition.
name_zh: 20寸几何凹凸硬壳万向轮登机箱 / 避震旅行拉杆箱 (玫瑰粉色/珊瑚粉)
description_zh: 低价转让一个标准的 20 英寸硬壳万向轮轻量登机箱（非常显眼的玫瑰粉/珊瑚粉色）。外壳采用轻量化耐磨 ABS/PC 材质，表面带有独特的几何交错凹凸条纹抗压设计，能有效缓冲撞击。配备 360 度多向旋转万向轮以及多档位可调节人体工学铝合金拉杆，在机场推行非常顺滑省力。尺寸完全符合绝大多数航空公司的手提行李/随身登机标准（可直接放入客舱头顶行李架）。**诚实瑕疵披露**：作为常用国际航班的登机箱，外壳有正常的航空托运磨损痕迹，正面贴有防碎（Fragile）红色标签及条码残留（如图所示），四角有轻微刮痕，但**所有轮子、拉链、提手和拉杆全部完好无损、功能完全正常**。**宠物家庭声明**：家里有猫，出货前内部内衬已完成深度吸尘清理，外部已进行酒精擦拭除尘，但因静电原因可能会有微量猫毛残余。本箱子不含原厂防尘布袋或外包装，自提买家开车直接整架放进后备箱或后排即可。
